title: PhD & Master in Advanced Computing
about: Tsinghua University's English-taught PhD and Master programmes in Advanced Computing admit international students for 2027. The first application round closes 15 December 2026 (17:00 Beijing time); a second round runs 1 January to 27 February 2027.
requirements: Foreign nationals who do not hold Chinese nationality
Degree (or CSCSE authentication for overseas degrees) before Tsinghua graduate registration in 2027
Non-native English speakers: TOEFL iBT 85 (tests before 21 January 2026) / 4.5 (tests from 21 January 2026) or IELTS 6.5
Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, or senior professionals in a related field
Chinese Government Scholarship applicants are strongly encouraged to apply in the first round

upskill.name: the full course catalog
why: The record's requirements ("Foreign nationals who do not hold Chinese nationality", "Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above", English test scores) are admission criteria that no course objective covers; the top shortlist scores come from incidental term matches ("comput", "recommendation", "advanced"), not genuine coverage, so this links to the EduCut AI Academy course catalog rather than a specific course
